Sure! Here’s an overview of how to install **dartfx**: | Step | What to Do | |------|------------| | 1️⃣ | **Prerequisites** – Make sure you have
• Dart SDK ≥ 2.19 installed.
• `pub` package manager available (comes with Dart).
• A working terminal/command prompt. | | 2️⃣ | **Clone the repo** (or download ZIP):
`git clone https://github.com/dartfx/dartfx.git && cd dartfx` | | 3️⃣ | **Install dependencies:**
`flutter pub get` (if it uses Flutter) or ` install`. | | 4️⃣ | **Build & run locally:**
`dart compile exe bin/main.dart -o build/bin/dartfx.exe` then execute from your shell (`./build/bin/dartfx`). | | 5️⃣ | **Optional – Set up environment variables**:
- For Windows: set PATH to include Dart SDK bin folder.
- On macOS/Linux: export `PATH="$HOME/.sdkman/candidates/dart/current/bin:$PATH"` (adjust based on where Dart was installed). | If you’re using a different operating system or need step‑by‑step details for a specific setup (e.g., Docker, CI/CD pipeline), let me know and I’ll tailor the guide further!
